items.title: Somalia braces for El Niño floods as millions face risk of hunger

items.title: Sudan: WFP Strongly Condemns Attack On Trucks In South Kordofan, Killing One Driver
items.description: One driver was killed in the air strike. We extend our deepest condolences to his family, friends and colleagues. The contracted trucks were en route from Dilling to Kadugli and clearly marked as humanitarian vehicles. Additional details regarding the circumstances of the incident, including the extent of the damage to the food cargo, are still being collected. WFP calls for a prompt and impartial investigation into this incident and for those responsible for any violations to be held accountable.
